projects.name: ML Model Comparator
projects.description: A universal Streamlit app that trains and compares six machine learning models on any CSV dataset, entirely in the browser. Upload data, pick a task and target, and get side-by-side metrics and visualisations with no pre-training. Built for the PGP in AI & DS program at Jio Institute and validated on the UCI Bank Marketing dataset.
features: Upload any CSV, preview its shape and column types, and auto-detect binary, multiclass or regression tasks.
Trains 6 models on the fly with an 80/20 split: Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, KNN, Naive Bayes, Random Forest and XGBoost.
One highlighted comparison table with the best value per metric (Accuracy, AUC, Precision, Recall, F1, MCC).
Drill-down per model with confusion matrix, radar chart, bar chart and classification report.
Automatic preprocessing: label encoding for categoricals and median fill for missing numerics.

projects.name: 3D Portfolio Website
projects.description: This portfolio: a scroll-driven, space-themed site with an image-sequence hero, an interactive 3D skills keyboard, a testimonials marquee and smooth motion design, tuned to stay fast on low-end devices.
features: Scrollytelling hero that scrubs a compressed frame sequence on canvas.
Interactive Spline-powered 3D keyboard with skills as keycaps.
Infinite, hover-to-pause testimonials marquee linking to LinkedIn profiles.
Lazy-loaded sections and 3D scenes, code-splitting and staged asset loading for speed.
Framer Motion and GSAP animations, a custom elastic cursor and a fully responsive layout.

projects.name: Energy Demand & Solar Forecasting
projects.description: A time series analysis project that forecasts Italy's 2016 electricity demand and solar power generation, supporting grid stability and renewable energy planning. Built as a team project for the Time Series Analysis course.
features: Preprocessing of hourly demand and solar records, with missing value and outlier handling.
Exploratory analysis of daily, weekly and yearly seasonality and the demand/solar relationship.
Trend, seasonality and residual decomposition, plus ADF stationarity tests and differencing.
Forecasting with ARIMA, SARIMA, Holt-Winters and Facebook Prophet, evaluated with RMSE, MAPE and MAE.
Forecast plots with confidence intervals and a model comparison report.

projects.name: Dementia Care Assistant
projects.description: A local-first, voice-based cognitive assessment agent for dementia care. A state-machine conversation engine runs memory, orientation, attention and planning tasks and scores them automatically, using locally hosted XTTS v2 for multilingual voice cloning.
features: Voice cloning with XTTS v2 so the assistant can speak in a familiar voice, all running locally.
Cognitive test flow: greeting, three-word memory test, intervening questions, delayed recall and summary.
Automated domain-wise scoring from Excellent to Needs Attention.
Simple HTML/JS front end with microphone recording and playback.
Local-first by design, with Docker Compose for the Flask and XTTS services.

projects.name: Ask My PDF
projects.description: A Next.js app that lets you upload a PDF and chat with it. It extracts and chunks the text, embeds it with OpenAI, retrieves the most relevant passages by cosine similarity and answers with GPT, with voice input for questions.
features: PDF upload with automatic text extraction and chunking (about 500 words with overlap).
Retrieval-augmented answers: embeddings plus cosine similarity pick the top matching chunks.
Chat with message history and real-time responses.
Speech-to-text question input using the Web Speech API.
Responsive interface, ready to deploy on Vercel.

projects.name: Pathfinder Visualizer
projects.description: An interactive web tool that visualises the A* and Dijkstra shortest-path algorithms on a grid. Draw your own mazes and watch each algorithm explore nodes and trace the final path in real time.
features: Side-by-side exploration of A* and Dijkstra's algorithm with step-by-step animation.
Interactive maze builder: place start and end points and draw obstacles with the mouse.
Colour-coded open set, closed set and final path for easy reading.
Responsive layout with a one-click grid reset.

projects.name: CineMatch
projects.description: A personalised movie recommendation app built with Streamlit. Pick a favourite film and it returns five similar titles using TF-IDF vectorisation and cosine similarity, with live posters pulled from the TMDB API.
features: Recommends 5 similar movies for any selected title.
Content-based filtering with TF-IDF and cosine similarity on the TMDB movie metadata dataset.
Fetches real-time movie posters from the TMDB API.
Simple Streamlit interface with precomputed similarity data for fast responses.

projects.name: FinanceMe DevOps Pipeline
projects.description: An end-to-end DevOps project for a banking and finance company moving from a monolith to microservices. Terraform provisions the AWS infrastructure, Jenkins automates build and deployment, and Prometheus and Grafana monitor everything.
features: Terraform provisions four AWS EC2 servers: Jenkins master, build, production and monitoring.
Jenkins CI/CD pipeline with a build slave that builds the app and Docker image and pushes to DockerHub.
Ansible deploys the Docker container to the production server.
Prometheus, Node Exporter and Grafana give continuous monitoring of the build and production servers.

projects.name: Smart Parking Assistant
projects.description: An IoT project that uses an Arduino and ten IR sensors to detect free parking spots and recommend the best one to drivers in real time, shown in a Python GUI. Built and demonstrated as a working hardware prototype.
features: Real-time monitoring of up to 10 parking spots with an Arduino sensor network.
Python and Tkinter GUI that visualises which spots are free or occupied.
Recommendation logic that suggests the closest available spot.
Customisable and expandable for different parking lot sizes.

projects.name: LSB Steganography
projects.description: A desktop app with a friendly GUI that hides secret text or files inside ordinary images using least significant bit steganography, and decodes them again without visibly changing the picture.
features: Encode text or image files inside any supported image format.
Decode the hidden text or image back out of the carrier image.
LSB technique keeps the carrier looking identical to the eye.
Tkinter GUI following PEP 8 conventions.
